campaign.title: M1 lower-cone t=1 moving-coefficient near-collision gate

resource_policy.literature_policy: Use primary matrix or double large-sieve, shifted-divisor, additive squarefree-correlation, and Kloosterman-fraction sources only after writing the literal two-row coefficient and the exact shifted-factor identity. Record theorem numbers, coefficient separability, averaging variables, smoothness, diagonal, modulus and shift ranges, and every translated R-M-D-E-Q power.

frozen_target.question: Does the complete nonzero near-collision collar in the exact Round-149 moving-row energy contribute O_epsilon(R^2 D X^epsilon), after an exact two-row expansion of both gcd-lift coefficients, prefixes, and profiles; if not, what is the first exact rank, cutoff, shifted-factor, source-hypothesis, D=1, or all-scale obstruction?
frozen_target.reference_formula: Let A_d(L,q)=chi_4(Lq)B_(d,U)(L)W_(d,U)(L/q)/L with (L,q)=1 and q asymp LQ. For q_i=h r_i, (r_1,r_2)=1, delta=L_1r_2-L_2r_1, choose k so rho=Ndelta-khr_1r_2 and |rho|<=hr_1r_2/2. Exact rho=0 is already owned. The Round-150 target is the absolute value of the full signed contribution of 0<|rho|<=hr_1r_2/D to sum_(d asymp D)mu^2(d)|G_U(d)|^2, bounded by R^2D X^epsilon, with the literal A_d coefficients.
quantities: For L=ts^2, a=(t,d_o), c=t/a, retain exactly the accepted closed formula B_(d,U)(ts^2)=mu(a)mu(c)mu(s)/c times the u|d_o/a and coprime v squarefree sums with kappa_(d,U)(au(csv)^2); B vanishes when (s,d_o)>1.
Expand the product B_(d,U)(L_1)conj(B_(d,U)(L_2)) through exact divisibility and coprimality masks before calling the coefficient arbitrary, low rank, separable, or of bounded variation.

Determine the exact d-dependence of both prefix indicators and sampled profiles from the accepted transform. Boundedness alone does not imply variation, and no continuous cutoff may replace the prefix.
Check the exact identity (NL_1-khr_1)(NL_2+khr_2)=N^2L_1L_2+kh rho, including signs, integrality, support, k=0, and possible zero or exceptional factors.
A divisor bound for fixed L_i,h,k,rho is incomplete until every shift and all coefficient weights are summed with a full power ledger.
Separate raw collar tuples, coefficient-weighted absolute mass, and the true signed mass carrying chi_4(L_1L_2r_1r_2).
Audit D=1 and L_1=L_2=1, where no d-average exists and the centered collar covers the full frequency range, as well as balanced and extreme aspects.
Retain even squarefree d, odd primes dividing d_o, q_i|N, common factors, imprimitive fractions, small reduced denominators, every clipped prefix, and all M<=R^2.
Classical fixed-vector large sieve, early Cauchy, an arbitrary-matrix counterexample, a conditional variation diagnostic, and a termwise L-to-powerful-H map are forbidden shortcuts.
The generic complement, every t>=2 layer, and the independent Round-138 cross owner remain separate unless the same proof explicitly controls them.

completion_criteria: Write the exact nonzero-collar contribution with every arithmetic coefficient, profile, prefix, parity, character, common divisor, and imprimitive denominator retained.
Derive an exact two-row divisor-incidence, Mellin, partial-summation, or finite-rank expansion with a quantitative norm, or prove the first literal rank, variation, or cutoff obstruction.
Prove and exploit, or rigorously rule out, the shifted-factor identity as a target-sized constrained divisor switch, with k=0 handled separately.
Give complete R-M-D-E-Q-L_i-h-k-rho power accounting and distinguish tuple count, weighted absolute mass, and signed mass.
Source-audit every imported matrix large-sieve, double-sieve, shifted-divisor, squarefree-correlation, or Kloosterman-fraction theorem against the exact collar.
Audit D=1, L_i=1, q_i|N, even d, primes dividing d_o, short prefixes, common factors, imprimitive denominators, and balanced and extreme aspects.
Prove the full collar target, isolate a strict owner-complete range, or identify a rigorous moving-coefficient collar no-go without turning an adverse upper capacity into a signed lower bound.
Close under exactly one label: moving_coefficient_collar_target, strict_moving_coefficient_collar_range, or moving_coefficient_collar_no_go.

tasks.target: Expand the literal two-row coefficient exactly, determine the true d-structure of the arithmetic coefficient, prefix, and profile, and attack the entire nonzero rho collar. Exploit the shifted-factor identity if lawful. Prove the R^2D collar target, a strict owner-complete range, or the first exact rank, variation, shift-summation, D=1, or power no-go.
required_output: The exact two-row coefficient expansion and shifted-factor ledger, including every exceptional case.
A target proof, strict owner-complete range, or first rigorous method-specific no-go.
Write only the assigned report and make no graph or shared-state edit.

tasks.target: Independently analyze the literal moving-coefficient nonzero collar from the statement only. excluded_context: all Round-138 through Round-150 nonblind artifacts
required_output: An independent collar theorem, strict range, or rigorous no-go with exact first doubtful step.
A complete D=1 and all-aspect falsifier ledger.

Supply a source-legal target theorem with full translation or the first exact coefficient, separability, shift, smoothness, diagonal, range, or power mismatch.

review_seams.requirement: Both closed B formulas, every divisibility and coprimality mask, both exact prefixes, both profiles, parity, and mod-four factors are independently checked.
The centered rho collar and shifted-factor identity have correct signs, integrality, support, k=0, exceptional-factor, common-divisor, and imprimitive cases.
Raw tuples, coefficient-weighted absolute mass, and signed mass are never conflated, and every h,k,rho,L_i shift is summed.
Every imported theorem matches the actual moving coefficient, averaging family, shifts, smoothness, diagonals, and all R-M-D-E-Q powers.
D=1, L_i=1, q_i|N, even d, primes dividing d_o, small denominators, short prefixes, balanced and extreme aspects all pass.
The generic complement, t>=2, Round-138 cross, lower GAR, M1, M2, endpoint, M9, bridge, target, and exponent are not promoted without complete owners.
